tz: dates are in the ad account timezone as returned by Meta
note: Catalog campaigns (campaign name contains 'CATALOG') broken down by product (Meta breakdowns=product_id), DAILY over 14 days including today, rolled up per MODEL CODE: every color/size variant of a model is summed into one row. The model code is the first 'X-1234' token found in the product label (name + retailer id), upper-cased, digits only after the dash (M-3352NVX1208 -> M-3352). Labels without a code go to '?'. Per campaign: models{code: {name, variants, totals7, totalsPrev7, daily[]}}; each daily row: date, spendUSD, impressions, clicks, purchases (omni_purchase, fallback purchase; null when zero). totals7 = last 7 days incl. today, totalsPrev7 = the 7 days before. error!=null means the fetch failed — the other Meta files are unaffected.
